summary: Acceptance 1: docs/procedures/nat-022/decon-trigger-facts.md records TRIG_CON, SHD_REG_UP_REQ, GLOBAL_CON and FRAME_COUNT with file/line from the pinned BSP f85e53cfa5497ead5d78821efbac84e51f37a4e1, the vendor command-mode frame sequence, and the DT facts (DECON0 op_mode 1, trig_mode 0; DECON1 trig_mode 1). Acceptance 2: canary-trig builds reproducibly (a second build into build-repro gave identical SHA-256 for all four images); canary-plain 7bc1b01d… and canary-fault 38a4feba… are byte-identical to build-001; host tests (test_nat022.py, 19 pass: Host, Trigger, VideoDecode, Aarch64Build) assert no MMIO before the first marker, only the four contract registers touched and only TRIG_CON/SHD_REG_UP_REQ written, nothing written when DECON is off, in video mode, with the MMU on or after a faulted kick, and the independent decoder reads the register report back. make check passed (214 tests; it does not include test_nat022.py, which was run directly). Acceptance 3 held when the host work was committed (0a603a4): nothing had been flashed or run and an image-specific decision request with SHA-256, writes, risks and recovery was put to the owner. That is superseded by later events recorded separately and not covered by this host-test evidence: the owner accepted it as decision 0010, one native run was made, and the owner's recording was decoded (docs/procedures/nat-022/native-attempt-002-evidence.json, native-device observation, outcome pass for 'one independent decoded marker'; cause of visibility, stride, exception path and XNU not established).
